[quote=oceanice_republics;60084799][spoiler=[i][u][b]Night March - Part IV: How Do I Start?[/b][/u][/i]]

[i]Gunfire erupts in the fog. Screams echo through the metal halls of the Opal Terminal. Sirens wail. Alarms flash red. Klaus stumbles backward, a bullet grazing his arm, his weapon slipping from his hand.

Klaus
He sees them.

The body*

The face of the resistance fighter lies in a pool of blood.  Eyes wide. Lifeless.
 
Its her

His sister.

Or rather a girl who looked just like her.

He drops to his knees*

[b]KLAUS shaking*[/b]
No no, not again

He doesnt see the boots stomping toward him until its too late.

[b]President Vanklyis furious, towering over Klaus*[/b]
LOOK WHAT YOU HAVE DONE, KLAUS!
 I raised you. I brought you to my home. You were like family.
 And now you point a weapon at your own blood?
 You try to kill your Führer?!
 *spits on the ground*
 You call yourself a man?

Klaus, wounded, breath shallow, looks up. Blood drips down his temple. But his eyes dont meet Vanklyiss. They look past him into something deeper. Everything goes silent.

[u][b]20 Years Ago | Were All Starts Its[/b][/u]

A Small Town in East off Oceanice
A peaceful farmhouse surrounded by pine trees.

Klaus, just a teenager, is laughing with his younger sister, who wears a red scarf and sketches in a notepad.

Their parents are reading by candlelight.

The radio crackles New decree issued. Mixed kin are now subject to screening and detainment.

*BOOM*...a sudden knock. Then boots. Then screaming.

The S.S.E. storms in.

Klaus is dragged out.

He watches, screaming, as his parents are executed.

His sister runs.

A gunshot*

Her red scarf floats in the snow.

Young Klaus, screaming, held down
She was just a kid! She wasnt a threat!

A young Vanklyis, not yet President, watching, silent.

[u][b]|Back to Present|[/b][/u]

Klaus whispers aloud, weakly*
That day You watched them die.

[b]President Vanklyis coldly*[/b]
That day, I saw who survives... and who doesnt.

[b]Klaus rasping, fury in his eyes*[/b]
You turned my pain into policy.
 And now you ask why I fight?

*He reaches for the detonator in his coat.*

Alexa bursts, gun drawn.

[b]Alexa[/b]
KLAUS! DONT!

He hesitates

BANG!*

Alexa fires.

Silence.

Klaus falls into Alexas arms, eyes wide with shock. Blood pools beneath them.

[b]Alexa choking*[/b] 
No no, no, no Klaus

[b]Vanklyis sternly[/b]
He was about to kill you. And me.
 He never cared, Alexa. He betrayed us all.

[b]Alexa screaming*[/b]
YOU made him this way! YOU!

Panzer-Cop reinforcements flood in(

[b]Vanklyis commanding*[/b]
Separate my son. Secure him. Take the traitors body.
Panzer Cop soldiers drag Klauss body away. Alexa struggles, yelling, as hes pulled from view.

[u][b]-Alexa Returns Home-[/b][/u]

Alexa returns home drunk, soaked in guilt. He slams a bottle to the floor. He stares at his shaking hands.

Luma stands at the table, holding something.

A letter.
She opens it.

[b]Klauss Voice reading*[/b]
Luma, if youre reading this it means I failed.
 But dont let them twist the truth.
 You are the last real thing in this world.
 Dont let them break you like they broke me.
 K

Lumas hands tremble. She drops the letter and looks toward Alexa.

He is crying.
Angry. Lost.
Guilt dripped from his every breath.
She wants to scream. But she is silent.

[u][b]-The Burning Grounds-[/b][/u]

Outside the city, deep in the Wastelands
Panzer-Cop and S.S.E. soldiers prepare to burn Klauss body in an incinerator trench.
One soldier lights a torch. Another removes the shroud from Klauss body.

Then, the wind dies.
A deep, inhuman voice cuts through the smoke
Step away, surface humans.
A shadow steps into the light.

A dark knight towering, armored in obsidian. Horns curl from his helmet, eyes glowing violet. His voice echoes like fractured steel.
That body does not belong to your world.

[b]1st Panzer-Cop shouting*[/b]
Identify yourself!

[b]3rd S.S.E.  raising weaapon*
[/b]Target approaching! Open fi
Before the shot is fired, the knight moves. Inhuman speed.
CLANG!  His blade slices through three soldiers in one motion.
A burst of purple magic knocks the others into the air.

[b]2nd Panzer-Cop  screaming*[/b]
WHAT IS THAT THING?!... Magic was gone for 100 years, HOW?!

[b]4th S.S.E. terrified[/b]
Its not human nor anthropomorphic !
The Knight raises a hand.
 The flames die. The sky darkens.
 He kneels beside Klauss body.
You still breathe Brother of Ash.

[b]KLAUSS EYES OPEN.[/b]
 He gasps for air.
...Where am I?

The knight lifts Klaus into his arms.
The last surviving soldier fires..
The knight turns. The bullet melts mid-air.
Your empire dies soon.
With that, the knight vanishes into black mistKlauss body disappears with him.
